## Summary

I've resolved ticket T-4004. The issue was that notification-worker was using a short service name ("smtp-relay") to connect to the SMTP relay after the platform team moved it to a different namespace (shared-infra). Kubernetes DNS can only resolve short names within the same namespace; cross-namespace access requires a fully qualified domain name. The fix is to update the notification-worker configuration to use `smtp-relay.shared-infra.svc.cluster.local` instead of just `smtp-relay`, then redeploy the application.
